facts.fact: Wyzowl's 2024 State of Video report found that 89% of people say they'd like to see more videos from brands.
facts.quote: According to Wyzowl's 2024 State of Video report, 89% of people say they'd like to see more videos from brands, and 91% of businesses use video as a marketing tool.

facts.fact: Cisco's Visual Networking Index states that video accounts for the majority of consumer internet traffic worldwide.
facts.quote: video accounts for the majority of consumer internet traffic worldwide, per Cisco's long-running Visual Networking Index.

facts.fact: The article states that YouTube is the world's second-largest search engine.
facts.quote: YouTube is the world's second-largest search engine.

facts.fact: Wavemaker builds an AI storyboard from 21 presets before generating visuals.
facts.quote: Wavemaker builds an AI storyboard from 21 presets, then generates custom images and video clips

facts.fact: According to the article, most Wavemaker videos come back in 2 to 5 minutes.
facts.quote: Most videos come back in 2 to 5 minutes.

facts.fact: The article says AI voiceover custom voice design is available on paid tiers.
facts.quote: an AI voiceover narrates the script (with custom voice design on paid tiers)

facts.fact: The article recommends a target length of 60-90 seconds for how-to/tutorial blog posts converted to video.
facts.quote: | How-to / tutorial | Step-by-step explainer | Sequential steps map cleanly to scenes and visuals | 60-90 sec |

facts.fact: The article recommends a target length of 45-75 seconds for listicle blog posts converted to video.
facts.quote: | Listicle ("7 ways to...") | Countdown or tips reel | Each item is a natural scene; easy to clip into shorts | 45-75 sec |

facts.fact: The article recommends a target length of 30-45 seconds for product or feature announcement posts converted to video.
facts.quote: | Product or feature announcement | Promo video | Built-in hook (the news) plus a clear call to action | 30-45 sec |

facts.fact: The article recommends a target length of 60-90 seconds for case study or results blog posts converted to video.
facts.quote: | Case study / results post | Story or testimonial-style | Narrative arc with concrete numbers holds attention | 60-90 sec |

facts.fact: The article recommends a target length of 45-60 seconds for opinion or thought leadership blog posts converted to video.
facts.quote: | Opinion / thought leadership | Talking-point explainer | Your point of view carries the video without heavy visuals | 45-60 sec |

facts.fact: The article recommends a target length of 60-90 seconds for data or research roundup posts converted to video.
facts.quote: | Data / research roundup | Stat-driven explainer | Numbers and charts translate well to on-screen visuals | 60-90 sec |

facts.fact: The article recommends a target length of 20-40 seconds per question for FAQ or glossary blog posts converted to video.
facts.quote: | FAQ / glossary post | Short answer clip (one per question) | Each Q&A becomes a standalone social short | 20-40 sec each |

facts.fact: The article advises generating a vertical 9:16 cut under 60 seconds for TikTok, Instagram, or Shorts.
facts.quote: For TikTok, Instagram, or Shorts, generate a vertical 9:16 cut and keep it under 60 seconds.

facts.fact: A 30-second Wavemaker video costs roughly 75 credits.
facts.quote: At roughly 75 credits for a 30-second video and 150 for a 60-second one, you can plan your credit budget against the number of posts you want to convert.

facts.fact: The Pro plan includes 2,000 monthly credits, which the page says covers roughly 26 thirty-second videos or 13 sixty-second ones.
facts.quote: A Pro plan's 2,000 monthly credits covers roughly 26 thirty-second videos or 13 sixty-second ones, and unused credits roll over 20%.

facts.fact: Credit packs never expire, according to the page.
facts.quote: Credit packs never expire, so a big one-time archive project doesn't force a subscription bump you don't need after.

facts.fact: Adwave's streaming TV commercial placements run on 100+ networks, starting from $50.
facts.quote: a finished Wavemaker video can run as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks, starting from $50

facts.fact: The free plan includes 75 credits at 480p with a watermark.
facts.quote: The free plan includes 75 credits (enough for your first video) at 480p with a watermark, and paid plans from $29/mo remove the watermark and unlock higher resolutions up to 4K.

facts.fact: Paid plans start from $29 per month and remove the watermark, unlocking resolutions up to 4K.
facts.quote: paid plans from $29/mo remove the watermark and unlock higher resolutions up to 4K.

facts.fact: Wavemaker exposes a REST API at /api/v1/videos and a 13-tool MCP server on Pro and up.
facts.quote: On Pro and up, Wavemaker exposes a REST API at `/api/v1/videos` plus a 13-tool MCP server

facts.fact: Wavemaker supports 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5 aspect ratio exports.
facts.quote: Wavemaker supports 16:9 for YouTube and blog embeds, 9:16 for TikTok and Reels and Shorts, plus 1:1 and 4:5 for feed posts.

facts.fact: Wavemaker can scrape a public URL, including brand colors and imagery, to create a video.
facts.quote: You can paste a public URL and Wavemaker will scrape the page (including your brand colors and imagery)
